jobs.title: Accounting Lead, Hardware
jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Controllership team delivers the financial truth that powers OpenAI’s growth. By translating operational activity into accurate, timely, and decision-grade financial data, we enable leadership to scale the business with confidence. Our commitment to rigorous controls and best-in-class systems ensures financial integrity as OpenAI grows. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Accounting Lead, Hardware to build and scale inventory accounting capabilities across consumer hardware and robotics businesses. This role partners closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Technical Accounting, Strategic Finance, and Systems teams to establish scalable inventory and supply chain accounting processes and reporting infrastructure supporting rapid growth and product launches. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting fundamentals, sound judgment, and a track record of building scalable processes in complex, evolving businesses. Inventory, cost accounting, or supply chain experience is preferred, and accounting experience supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, or other capital-intensive operations is also valuable. We welcome strong accounting professionals from other backgrounds who have demonstrated the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar business models and accounting topics and take ownership of new areas. This person should thrive in ambiguity, combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners and senior leadership. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: INVENTORY ACCOUNTING - Lead inventory and supply chain accounting across consumer hardware and robotics programs, including inventory valuation, supply chain/sourcing arrangements, manufacturing variances, reserves, and close processes. - Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Strategic Finance to support BOM accuracy, labor and overhead assumptions, operationalize supply chain strategies and gross margin analysis. - Develop scalable accounting processes for NPI, prototyping, engineering builds, and mass production. - Own inventory-related accounting policies and controls, including capitalization, overhead allocation, LCNRV/NRV assessments, rebates, freight, tariffs, and inventory controls. ERP SYSTEMS & PROCESS DESIGN - Serve as a finance lead for Oracle Fusion manufacturing costing and inventory implementations, enhancements, and process optimization. - Partner with Systems, IT, and Operations to design scalable finance processes, controls, reporting structures, and operational workflows. - Partner with Systems and Operations to define accounting requirements and guide ERP design for product costing, inventory transactions, and related reporting and controls. FINANCIAL CLOSE, REPORTING & CONTROLS - Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting close activities and improve scalable reconciliations, reporting, and management review processes. - Partner with Strategic Finance on margin reporting, inventory analytics, and budget versus actual analysis. - Establish SOX-ready controls, support audits and technical accounting matters, and drive continuous improvement across close and reporting processes. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP - Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Program Management teams. - Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks. - Influence senior stakeholders through strong communication, executive presence, and data-driven recommendations. - Help build and scale the long-term roadmap for hardware controllership, manufacturing accounting, and operational finance infrastructure. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Bring strong accounting judgment and enjoy learning how physical products, infrastructure, and operational workflows translate into financial reporting. - Have a track record of quickly developing expertise in unfamiliar accounting areas, asking thoughtful questions, and turning what you learn into practical processes and controls. - Can comfortably operate between strategic leadership discussions and highly detailed operational accounting analyses. - Have strong executive presence and can communicate effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional partners. - Enjoy building scalable processes and infrastructure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. - Are highly detail-oriented and maintain a strong control mindset while balancing business partnership. - Have a strong systems orientation and enjoy designing scalable ERP and reporting processes. - Are intellectually curious, proactive, and solutions-oriented. QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, with ownership of complex accounting areas, close processes, or operational accounting. - Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar accounting topics and apply sound judgment. - Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new business models, systems, and operational processes and take ownership of unfamiliar accounting areas. - Experience building or improving accounting processes, reconciliations, controls, and reporting. - Strong systems aptitude and experience working with ERP systems and financial data. - Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills. - Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and execute effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable; candidates are not expected to bring all of them: - Inventory, cost, manufacturing, or supply chain accounting, including inventory valuation, standard costing, manufacturing variances, overhead allocation, rebates and buy/sell etc. - Accounting supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, electronics, robotics, semiconductors, or other capital-intensive operations. - Work with contract manufacturers, global supply chains, hardware product launches, or manufacturing scale-up. - Oracle Fusion, particularly Costing and Inventory modules, or comparable ERP implementation and process improvement experience. - CPA and/or public accounting background. - Experience in a high-growth technology environment or building and leading accounting teams. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS This role will play a foundational part in building the accounting infrastructure that supports the next generation of AI hardware products. You will help shape the systems, policies, controls, and operational processes that enable scalable manufacturing operations, reliable financial reporting, and launch readiness as the business rapidly grows. You’ll have the opportunity to work cross-functionally with world-class teams at the forefront of AI, robotics, and consumer hardware innovation while helping build a best-in-class hardware controllership organization from the ground up. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Data Scientist - Full Stack App Development — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Data Scientist - Full Stack App Development opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY The Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead (BR PCRU Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead) provides strategic and operational leadership for participants recruitment at the Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, ensuring high-quality service delivery. The Lead ensures ethical, inclusive, and participant-centred identification, engagement, pre-screening, and enrolment of healthy volunteers and special populations while safeguarding participants’ rights, safety and privacy. The role supports timely, compliant study delivery and translates site and portfolio priorities into data driven recruitment strategies aligned with R&D goals. The Lead builds high-performing teams that responsibly use approved AI, automation, risk based strategy and analytics to improve targeting, forecasting, database management, and decision-making while maintaining human oversight, ethics, and participants data privacy. Key accountabilities include: local recruitment strategy and delivery; study feasibility and portfolio forecasting; enrolment-risk management; participant experience and ethical recruitment; team, capacity and budget leadership; recruitment data quality and privacy compliance; vendor/channel performance; digital enablement and continuous improvement; local cross-functional coordination; and cross-site sharing of practice through PCRU governance JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Recruitment Governance and Resource Oversight: Capacity and resource planning Colleague and contractor allocation Recruitment channel and vendor management Advertising, outreach and budget management Workload, training and competency oversight Team Performance management Inspection and audit readiness Business continuity to sustain critical recruitment activities during operational disruption or resource constraints. Database health and participant-contact quality supporting privacy, data quality and positive participant engagement. Strategic Participant Recruitment & Portfolio Delivery Recruitment strategy: Lead the development and delivery of the Brussels PCRU participant recruitment strategy in line with site priorities and the resource parameters established by the Brussels Site Head. Predictive planning and protocol feasibility: Shape early study strategy by assessing recruitment feasibility, developing evidence-based plans aligned with timelines, quality and budget, and proactively mitigating or escalating risks. Compliance, ethics and process improvement: Develop, implement and continuously improve applicable local procedures, ensuring team compliance with relevant Pfizer policies, SOPs and work instructions. Participant data stewardship: Ensure recruitment data are collected, maintained, accessed and used in accordance with privacy requirements, consent provisions, Pfizer standards and defined data-owner and data-steward accountabilities. Digital Innovation, Automation & Responsible Adoption Digitalization and automation opportunities: Identify high-value opportunities to simplify processes, increase efficiency and improve operational outcomes through appropriate digital tools and automation. Cross-functional solution delivery: Partner with Digital and Data Science teams to assess, pilot and implement approved solutions that address defined operational needs. Responsible adoption and oversight: Maintain appropriate human oversight and ensure that all solutions meet applicable privacy, compliance and governance requirements. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Education: Bachelor’s degree in life science, health-related, data science, or healthcare administration discipline is required. Clinical Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in clinical trial operations or participant recruitment, with at least 7 years within a pharmaceutical company or a Contract Research Organization (CRO) environment. Digital & Analytics Literacy: Demonstrated experience evaluating, adopting, or implementing advanced digital systems, automated databases, or AI-enabled tools to optimize operations, analyze datasets, and support executive-level business decisions. Leadership Track Record: Minimum of 5 years of experience leading teams, managing personnel, directing complex operational processes, and navigating organizational change management. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Strategic & Systems Thinking: Outstanding capability to translate complex operational data, digital dashboards, and AI-generated models into clear, actionable recruitment strategies and executive-level recommendations. Regulatory Mastery: Thorough and deep understanding of Phase I clinical operations, ICH-GCP, European and Belgian clinical trial regulations, and data privacy laws (GDPR). Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to lead and align cross-functional, multi-disciplinary stakeholder groups behind strategic goals. Problem-Solving: Strong, proactive risk-management capability, with expertise in scenario modeling, continuous operational improvement methodologies, and structured root-cause analysis. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Reporting line: Reports to Head, Global PCRU Pharmaceutical Operations - Site Lead RESOURCES MANAGED Manage the BR PCRU Participants Recruitment department with approximately 12 Headcounts: 8 direct reports and 4 indirect reports Work Location Assignment: Hybrid (some office presence is required) The closing deadline for applications is November 17th 2026. Pfizer discovers, develops, manufactures and distributes medicines and vaccines. Pfizer wants to contribute to better health and wellness for everyone, at every stage of life. Pfizer works with the government and other health partners to provide quality and accessible healthcare. The patient is central to this story. Pfizer has four offices in Belgium with which it supports its Belgian and international activities: 1) Anderlecht, where the Pfizer Clinical Research Unit is located. This is a fully equipped phase 1 research center. With that of New Haven (US), it is one of two Phase 1 Pfizer research centers in the world, 2) Elsene , the Belgian headquarters, 3) Puurs , Pfizer's production and packaging site, and 4) Zaventem, the international Pfizer's Logistics Center. More information can be found at www.pfizer.com , www.pfizer.be and on Facebook and Twitter. Pfizer's aim is to provide equality of opportunity in the recruitment process by avoiding any bias or potential discrimination on any grounds including (but not limited to): sex, age, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation or disability. At Pfizer we are creating an organization and promoting a culture that respects each individual's unique character and life experiences and reflects the diversity of our society, customers and markets. We will achieve this through fostering and sustaining an environment in which every colleague feels valued and supported. Disability Inclusion Our mission is unleashing the power of all our people and we are proud to be a disability inclusive employer, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all candidates. We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. Your journey with Pfizer starts here! jobs.title: Manager, Lease Accounting
jobs.description: About the Team The DoorDash Lease Accounting team ensures DoorDash’s lease portfolio is reported accurately and on time under ASC 842. This requires deep technical accounting review and careful interpretation of complex, often ambiguous lease arrangements. As the portfolio grows in size and complexity, we continue to strengthen our processes to keep pace with the business. About the Role You will report to the Senior Accounting Manager on our Lease Accounting team. As the Lease Accounting Manager, you will be a key technical expert on ASC 842, ensuring DoorDash’s leases are accounted for accurately as the business grows. This role is built for someone who takes ownership, stays ahead of the work, and works closely with partners across functions. Success means well-supported conclusions and dependable reporting each period, with the opportunity to apply your expertise to increasingly complex leases. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Review lease abstractions against new lease agreements and lease modifications to ensure accurate classification and recognition of each lease in accordance with ASC 842. Perform detailed accounting analysis of complex lease arrangements and unique scenarios that go beyond standard treatment, documenting conclusions and supporting analysis. Perform lease monthly close activities including journal entries, account reconciliations, and flux analysis Own lease financial reporting deliverables, including cash flows, rollforwards, and disclosures. Partner closely with Real Estate, Lease Administration and other cross-functional teams to understand lease activity early and keep the accounting accurate and timely. Proactively identify and lead process improvements and automation initiatives to reduce manual work and improve the accuracy and efficiency of processes. Maintain lease SOX controls and support both internal and external audit requests. We’re excited about you because… Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, or a related field, and/or equivalent work experience. 6+ years accounting experience, including in-depth experience applying US GAAP lease accounting (ASC 842), which is essential to this role. Proven experience reviewing lease agreements, interpreting lease terms, and assessing their financial implications to determine the appropriate accounting treatment. Ownership mindset and proactiveness, with a track record of managing multiple deliverables and following them through to completion on close timelines. Strong cross-functional partnership and communication skills to work effectively with internal and external partners. Close attention to detail and demonstrated problem-solving skills. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others. jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Programs
jobs.description: Role Description Dropbox is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Customer Programs to lead complex, cross-functional programs that deepen how we engage, learn from, and deliver value to our customers. This role sits at the intersection of customers, GTM, and Product. You will lead programs that bring customers into important moments across the product and customer lifecycle - from early product learning and customer validation to launches, adoption, advocacy, and strategic customer engagement. You’ll ensure we are engaging the right customers for the right purpose, creating a coordinated experience across Dropbox, and turning what we learn into clear actions for the business. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant autonomy and executive visibility. You’ll take high-priority initiatives that often span multiple functions, have evolving requirements, or lack an established operating model and turn them into well-run programs. You’ll define the objective, determine the right program approach, align stakeholders, establish ownership and decision points, manage dependencies and risks, and drive execution through measurable outcomes. A critical part of the role is representing the customer experience across the entire program, not simply coordinating internal teams. You’ll think deliberately about who we engage, why we are engaging them, what we are asking of them, how Dropbox shows up across touchpoints, and how we close the loop on their participation. The customer should experience one coordinated Dropbox program even when many internal teams are involved behind the scenes. You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Research, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Analytics, and other teams depending on the program. Over time, you’ll also help Dropbox build more repeatable ways to run customer programs - creating playbooks and operating mechanisms that allow successful approaches to scale without creating unnecessary process. Responsibilities Lead complex customer programs end-to-end, translating ambiguous business priorities into clear objectives, operating plans, milestones, decision points, owners, risks, and measurable outcomes. Create a coordinated customer experience across Dropbox by partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and other teams to ensure customers receive clear expectations, thoughtful engagement, and appropriate follow-through. Lead large cross-functional teams through competing priorities, dependencies, and ambiguity, driving decisions and accountability without relying on formal authority. Connect customer signal to action by ensuring feedback, behavior, and program results reach the right Product and GTM owners and translate into decisions, changes, or clearly documented next steps. Build practical and scalable program infrastructure - including workbacks, decision rights, readiness criteria, status mechanisms, risk/escalation paths, measurement, and reusable playbooks - while avoiding unnecessary process. Provide clear executive-level synthesis of program health, customer signal, risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and recommendations. Requirements 8+ years of experience in program management, customer programs, strategy & operations, GTM operations, product operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional programs. Demonstrated ability to take a highly ambiguous initiative from problem definition through execution, measurement, and outcome, operating independently with limited direction. Experience leading programs involving customers or customer-facing teams, with strong judgment around customer selection, engagement, communications, expectations, and experience. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple senior stakeholders and functions with different priorities, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining momentum and accountability. Strong operating judgment: able to determine the appropriate level of structure for a problem, make tradeoffs, simplify where possible, and build repeatable mechanisms where needed. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into concise recommendations, decisions, and executive updates. Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on senior IC, moving comfortably between strategic problem-solving and the detailed execution required to deliver a program successfully. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading customer programs involving early product feedback, beta/early-access programs, customer validation, product launches, adoption, advocacy, or strategic customer engagement. Experience working across both Product/EPD and GTM organizations and translating customer needs and business requirements between the two. Experience building a new program or operating model and scaling it across products, customer segments, or business priorities. Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, collaboration/productivity technology, or another complex technology environment. Experience using AI and automation to improve program execution, customer insights, synthesis, reporting, or operating efficiency. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations .

jobs.title: Facilities Coordinator 2
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. Facilities Coordinator: Onsite, Eindhoven (Netherlands) Bring your curiosity. Make an impact. Help keep the work behind groundbreaking science moving forward. At Illumina, every role has the opportunity to make a difference. As our Facilities Coordinator , you’ll provide essential operational and systems support across Facilities Operations, Site Services, Engineering and related business functions across EMEA. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity, working with systems and data, and helping colleagues get the accurate information they need. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where attention to detail matters, continuous improvement is encouraged, and you can grow through meaningful, hands-on experience. What you’ll do At the heart of this role is making sure our facilities information, systems and processes work effectively day to day. You will: Maintain accurate electronic filing systems, records and documentation. Support essential back-office administration and operational processes. Provide support across facilities systems including ServiceNow, Team Center, SAP EAM/Fiori and Archibus . Support routine financial administration using tools such as Ariba and Icertis , helping with purchasing processes and budget tracking. Provide global support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and escalate identified risks or issues. Review and help improve SharePoint sites. Assist with on-site vendors. Support the planning, reporting and tracking of operational activities, actions and priorities. Responsibilities and systems may vary depending on business needs and reporting lines. Reasonable accommodations may be made in response to business conditions and additional responsibilities. Full training will be provided. What you’ll bring You don’t need to know everything on day one. We’re looking for someone with strong systems capability, an eye for detail and the curiosity to keep learning and improving. You’ll ideally bring: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. Confidence using Microsoft applications, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint . Strong IT and systems skills. The ability to identify issues and contribute to problem solving and process improvement. Excellent organisation, prioritisation and time-management skills. The ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines, including when resources are limited. The confidence to work independently while also contributing as part of a team. A constructive, collaborative approach when working with employees, managers and cross-functional colleagues. Adaptability in a fast-moving environment, including changing demands and different time zones. Experience using procurement platforms such as Ariba, Icertis or similar tools , databases or other business systems would be an advantage. Experience within facilities, operations, engineering support, workplace services, compliance or another regulated environment would also be beneficial. The Illumina experience Every role at Illumina contributes to something bigger. Our people are connected by purpose, and meaningful work happens through collaboration across the business. Here, growth comes through experience: taking on new challenges, learning from expertise around you and looking for better ways to get things done. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to build your knowledge across systems and operations while supporting teams across EMEA. If you’re organised, systems-minded, collaborative and ready to bring your curiosity to a role where the details matter, we’d love to hear from you. Bring your curiosity and make an impact. The estimated base salary range for the Facilities Coordinator 2 role based in Netherlands is EUR 30,400 - 45,600. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. This salary range applies to the primary posting location listed above. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range will be updated accordingly. Compensation ranges for other locations will differ to reflect local market competitiveness and will be shared with candidates if applicable during the recruitment process. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your wellbeing, flexibility, and life beyond work—combining globally differentiated offerings with locally tailored programs. This includes support during important life moments, flexible time off, opportunities to give back, and a weeklong company-wide summer shutdown. In the Netherlands, we offer an 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld) in addition to the salary listed above. We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected or the requisition has a sufficient number of qualified applicants. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Advanced Specialist, New Verticals Merchant Sentiment
jobs.description: About the Team Our New Verticals Merchant Sentiment team ensures that when things go wrong in the last mile, there's always someone there to help. Our team creates and administers DoorDash's massive and expanding global network of support centers to provide the greatest customer experiences possible, with the ultimate goal of delivering an exceptional customer experience as efficiently and reliably as possible to our merchants. This team meticulously optimizes the Managed Merchant interface across all facets of the DoorDash platform. They handle everything from setting up essential account information like bank routing to helping merchants update and expand their inventory and ensure their POS integration system is operating effectively.. Additionally, they actively participate in quarterly business reviews to measure and enhance Managed Merchant revenue, ensuring continuous comprehensive support and improvement. At DoorDash, we believe in fostering a culture of meaningful connection, collaboration, and professional growth through in-office interactions. This position requires an in-office presence at the DoorDash corporate office in Tempe and the employee must live within a commutable 50 miles from the office. In-office days are determined by the business and can change based on business needs. About the Role We are searching for a Merchant Sentiment Specialist to work with our New Vertical Merchants, both managed and unmanaged, solving their most pressing challenges and creating opportunities to improve their overall experience as we continue to scale our last-mile logistics platform. This role will be assigned a schedule that may include evenings, weekends, and holidays. These schedules will be adjusted periodically to meet the needs of our business. As a Merchant Sentiment Specialist, you will partner with Account Owners (AO) to ensure overall Merchant success on the DoorDash platform through proactive and reactive contacts. This includes but is not limited to weekly syncs with your AO partners and recurring meetings with the Managed Merchants on your assigned roster. cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Oncology Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Oncology Specialist opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description Engineer - Inspection & Packaging Job Description Amgen Dun Laoghaire (ADL) is looking for an Inspection & Packaging Engineer to join our Inspection & Packaging team to support the continued expansion of the plant and production capability on site. The engineer will report to the Engineering Manager and should have knowledge and proficiency in the use of statistical analysis tools, continuous improvement methodologies, problem solving and applied engineering skills relating to mechanical, electro-mechanical and associated automation systems. The engineer will also have full overall responsibility for the reliability and life cycle of equipment. jobs.description: Role Description Dropbox is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Customer Programs to lead complex, cross-functional programs that deepen how we engage, learn from, and deliver value to our customers. This role sits at the intersection of customers, GTM, and Product. You will lead programs that bring customers into important moments across the product and customer lifecycle - from early product learning and customer validation to launches, adoption, advocacy, and strategic customer engagement. You’ll ensure we are engaging the right customers for the right purpose, creating a coordinated experience across Dropbox, and turning what we learn into clear actions for the business. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant autonomy and executive visibility. You’ll take high-priority initiatives that often span multiple functions, have evolving requirements, or lack an established operating model and turn them into well-run programs. You’ll define the objective, determine the right program approach, align stakeholders, establish ownership and decision points, manage dependencies and risks, and drive execution through measurable outcomes. A critical part of the role is representing the customer experience across the entire program, not simply coordinating internal teams. You’ll think deliberately about who we engage, why we are engaging them, what we are asking of them, how Dropbox shows up across touchpoints, and how we close the loop on their participation. The customer should experience one coordinated Dropbox program even when many internal teams are involved behind the scenes. You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Research, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Analytics, and other teams depending on the program. Over time, you’ll also help Dropbox build more repeatable ways to run customer programs - creating playbooks and operating mechanisms that allow successful approaches to scale without creating unnecessary process. Responsibilities Lead complex customer programs end-to-end, translating ambiguous business priorities into clear objectives, operating plans, milestones, decision points, owners, risks, and measurable outcomes. Create a coordinated customer experience across Dropbox by partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and other teams to ensure customers receive clear expectations, thoughtful engagement, and appropriate follow-through. Lead large cross-functional teams through competing priorities, dependencies, and ambiguity, driving decisions and accountability without relying on formal authority. Connect customer signal to action by ensuring feedback, behavior, and program results reach the right Product and GTM owners and translate into decisions, changes, or clearly documented next steps. Build practical and scalable program infrastructure - including workbacks, decision rights, readiness criteria, status mechanisms, risk/escalation paths, measurement, and reusable playbooks - while avoiding unnecessary process. Provide clear executive-level synthesis of program health, customer signal, risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and recommendations. Requirements 8+ years of experience in program management, customer programs, strategy & operations, GTM operations, product operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional programs. Demonstrated ability to take a highly ambiguous initiative from problem definition through execution, measurement, and outcome, operating independently with limited direction. Experience leading programs involving customers or customer-facing teams, with strong judgment around customer selection, engagement, communications, expectations, and experience. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple senior stakeholders and functions with different priorities, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining momentum and accountability. Strong operating judgment: able to determine the appropriate level of structure for a problem, make tradeoffs, simplify where possible, and build repeatable mechanisms where needed. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into concise recommendations, decisions, and executive updates. Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on senior IC, moving comfortably between strategic problem-solving and the detailed execution required to deliver a program successfully. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading customer programs involving early product feedback, beta/early-access programs, customer validation, product launches, adoption, advocacy, or strategic customer engagement. Experience working across both Product/EPD and GTM organizations and translating customer needs and business requirements between the two. Experience building a new program or operating model and scaling it across products, customer segments, or business priorities. Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, collaboration/productivity technology, or another complex technology environment. Experience using AI and automation to improve program execution, customer insights, synthesis, reporting, or operating efficiency. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it.
